jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About Umain

Umain, part of Eidra, is a digital product consultancy with nearly 200 engineers, designers, and product strategists. We partner with companies including McDonald’s, Polestar, Heineken, Rijksmuseum, Spotify, and Philips Hue to shape, build, and scale the products and platforms their businesses and customers rely on. We work in small, senior teams, staying with a product from its first idea through launch and beyond.

Umain is growing its AI engineering team in the US. Our AI engineers around the world design, prototype and build AI-powered tools and software that change how clients work, from advanced GenAI workflows and custom agents to production-ready AI applications. You'll join a global team of more than 30 AI engineers across Sweden, the Netherlands, Norway, and North America, working alongside strategy consultants, marketers, data experts and designers.

This full time role is based in Chicago at our West Loop office. As part of Umain's expanding U.S. footprint, you'll help establish our reputation for engineering excellence, strategy, and delivery in the American market. You must be in Chicago or willing to relocate to be considered for this role as we require a minimum of 3 days in-office per week.

Your role

As an AI Engineer at Umain, you’ll build the next generation of AI-powered products, workflows, and agents for our clients, combining strong software engineering fundamentals and full-stack product thinking with modern AI capabilities. Your work will range from integrating LLMs and vision models to architecting agents, building scalable pipelines and experimenting with new techniques.

You’ll turn ambiguous ideas into robust solutions, evaluate where AI truly adds value and help clients understand what is possible, feasible, and responsible—all while playing an active role in shaping our growing AI practice.

What you'll do

Partner with clients to clarify their challenges, decide whether AI is the right answer and assess feasibility and risk, including data security, privacy, licensing, and responsible AI.
Design, prototype, build, and ship AI-powered applications, workflows, and agents for clients ranging from start-ups to global enterprises.
Architect agentic systems, including context management, memory, orchestration, and the tools, skills, and MCP integrations agents rely on.
Select, integrate, and adapt foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others). Fine-tune or combine them when off-the-shelf options fall short.
Design around model limitations in both the architecture and the product's UX. Apply techniques like retrieval, chunking, embeddings, and redlining, and debug AI systems when they misbehave.
Build evaluation and observability into everything you ship. Use stochastic test cases, trace-based analysis, and tools to benchmark and monitor models, prompts, and agents.
Build the software, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP, or AWS) that keep AI products running reliably at scale.
Own parts of project delivery, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and lead client and internal workshops.
Bring technical credibility to new business. You'll join pitches as our AI expert, shape proposals and RFP responses, and help prospective clients see what's possible.
Help define Umain's AI offerings and grow the competence through internal frameworks, playbooks, knowledge sessions, and engineering standards.

What you'll do

Partner with clients to clarify their challenges, decide whether AI is the right answer and assess feasibility and risk, including data security, privacy, licensing, and responsible AI.
Design, prototype, build, and ship AI-powered applications, workflows, and agents for clients ranging from start-ups to global enterprises.
Architect agentic systems, including context management, memory, orchestration, and the tools, skills, and MCP integrations agents rely on.
Select, integrate, and adapt foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others). Fine-tune or combine them when off-the-shelf options fall short.
Design around model limitations in both the architecture and the product's UX. Apply techniques like retrieval, chunking, embeddings, and redlining, and debug AI systems when they misbehave.
Build evaluation and observability into everything you ship. Use stochastic test cases, trace-based analysis, and tools to benchmark and monitor models, prompts, and agents.
Build the software, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP, or AWS) that keep AI products running reliably at scale.
Own parts of project delivery, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and lead client and internal workshops.
Bring technical credibility to new business. You'll join pitches as our AI expert, shape proposals and RFP responses, and help prospective clients see what's possible.
Help define Umain's AI offerings and grow the competence through internal frameworks, playbooks, knowledge sessions, and engineering standards.

What you bring

Approximately 8 years engineering experience that includes at least 4 years building AI-powered systems, or equivalent hands-on experience shipping AI in production systems.
Hands-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, prompt and context engineering, retrieval setups, fine-tuning, and model evaluation.
Experience building agents, including memory, tool use, and orchestration, with at least one modern agent framework.
Experience integrating AI services such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Meta models.
Strong software engineering skills in TypeScript and/or Python, including real backend systems and data pipelines.
Full-stack product thinking: frontend or backend experience outside the traditional AI field, and the ability to build end to end.
Proven experience deploying and running scalable applications in Azure, GCP, or AWS.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and modern DevOps practices. You can take a solution from "it works on my laptop" to "it runs reliably in the cloud."
A track record of delivering AI solutions, not just prototypes.
A pragmatic mindset and the judgment to know when AI is the right tool and when it isn't.
The ability to turn vague questions into concrete technical solutions for our clients.
Strong communication skills and comfort working in multidisciplinary teams.
Curiosity about emerging AI capabilities, creativity in applying them, and enthusiasm for exploring new approaches.

Nice-to-haves

Experience with machine learning, computer vision, generative images, and/or multimodal models.
Experience in consultancy or client-facing environments.

What we offer

At Eidra, we offer a competitive salary package complemented by comprehensive benefits that prioritize employee well-being, reflecting our Nordic heritage. We provide a range of healthcare benefits, including fully subsidized insurance premiums for employees and their families. Our vacation policy promotes work-life balance with flexible time off, requiring a minimum of 3 weeks off per year. We encourage employees to take vacations in 2-week increments to truly detach and recharge. Our culture emphasizes inclusive decision-making, collaboration, and continuous learning, fostering an environment of transparency and trust.

Compensation ranges from $130,000–$170,000 USD annual salary dependent on experience

Umain North America is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

Umain is a digital product consultancy. We shape, ship and scale digital products at speed. Founded in Stockholm in 2001, we are a growing team of 100+ experts in digital product strategy, design, and technology.

We are a part of Eidra, a group of top-notch companies specializing in strategy, creativity, and engineering. As a collective we guide leaders in making meaningful and lasting change.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Infrastructure
jobs.description:
We are hiring an Engineer to join our Data Engineering Infrastructure team, where you will help build and scale the storage and data platforms that power our HFT business. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working close to the bare metal systems. Operating large-scale open-source storage, enterprise storage, tuning Linux systems for performance, automating infrastructure. As our data footprint grows, you will play a key part in keeping our infrastructure fast, reliable, and ready to scale.

Your Core Responsibilities

Design, deploy, and operate large-scale data storage infrastructure, including Hadoop, enterprise storage and S3-compatible platforms
Tune Linux systems for I/O throughput and overall performance
Automate configuration and deployment using Ansible, Puppet or other automation platform
Build observability into the platform with Prometheus and related tooling
Partner with engineering teams to deliver reliable, well-architected data solutions with a focus on Storage and Kafka
Familiarity with Kubernetes

Your Skills & Experience

5+ years of experience in systems engineering with a strong focus on data storage
Strong Linux fundamentals, debugging skills, including performance tuning for I/O throughput
Hands-on experience with Ansible and Puppet for configuration management and automation
Familiarity with open-source, S3 API compliant, and enterprise storage technologies
Working knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem, including YARN
Experience in Java and Python
Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude in an enterprise setting
Experience with Prometheus-based monitoring and alerting

The Base Salary range for the role is included below. Base salary is only one component of total compensation; all full-time, permanent positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits, including paid leave and insurance. Please visit Benefits - US | IMC Trading for more comprehensive information.

Base Salary Range
$175,000 - $225,000 USD

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - IT III
jobs.description:
Workday HCM Reporting Analyst 

Location: Chicago IL - Hybrid onsite 

Duration: 3 Months to begin 

Job Description:

Client is seeking a detail?oriented Data Analyst to support a major HR systems transformation as the organization migrates from PeopleSoft to Workday.
This role will work closely with HR, and external partners to ensure Workday reporting and analytics is ready for deployment and hypercare support after deployment
The ideal candidate brings strong Workday report-building experience, thrives in large datasets, and can identify mismatches with precision. Prism experience is a plus, but Workday expertise is more critical.

Pay Range: $46- $48

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.
